blurb: Night Shift Brewing operates multiple locations including taprooms and seasonal beer gardens where guests can enjoy a wide selection of beverages including beer, cocktails, wines, and non-alcoholic options. Locations feature dog-friendly patios, live music, food trucks, and community events. The brewery emphasizes inclusivity, creativity, and community engagement.
